title: OpenAI provider: Preserve file_id when converting file citations to sources
body:
### Description

The OpenAI responses API returns file citations with **file_id**. This information is lost when converting file citations to sources in the content array. For example https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/27e8c3aad8e3cdd73f5d8f454cbca92b34580ac2/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L478-L486

For our use case, we've implemented our chatbot as an api that adheres to the openai responses API spec, and we've implemented file citations in a way where file_id contains necessary information about the file. It would be nice to preserve the file_id in the source.

### AI SDK Version

"@ai-sdk/openai": "2.0.32",
